context: A boss reviews policy outreach with his manager
purpose: Teach: ビラ/トピックス/ナショナリズム/ビジネスマン/プラザ/農林省/リーディング/請願

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今週のトピックス、農林省の発表が大きいな。
lines.en: This week's big story is the agriculture ministry's announcement.
lines.style: Calm, scanning tone. Glances up from briefing papers. Factual without emphasis. Looking for acknowledgment more than reaction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界リーディング企業として、こちらの見解も出した方がいいかと。
lines.en: Yes. I think as an industry leader, we should put out a statement of our own.
lines.style: Respectful and measured. Slight forward lean. Professional but not defensive. Suggesting rather than asserting, eyes up toward his boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 駅前のプラザで開かれる説明会、参加するか?
lines.en: Are you considering attending that briefing at the station plaza?
lines.style: Practical tone. Quick, direct question. Looking for a simple yes or no. No extra warmth — just operational.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 参加して、ビラも配布する方向で準備しています。
lines.en: We're planning to attend and distribute flyers there as well.
lines.style: Assured, competent delivery. Sits slightly taller. This is already in motion — he's reporting progress, not asking permission. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ビジネスマン向けの内容に絞れ。ナショナリズム的な煽りは避けろ。
lines.en: Keep it business-focused. Avoid any nationalist slant.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Two separate commands. First is measured; second drops slightly lower, with weight on the warning. Direct eye contact. No room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。請願書の文面も、中立で押し通します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the petition language stays neutral all the way through.
lines.style: Crisp, immediate acknowledgment. Slight nod on "understood". Fast-paced, professional. Shows he's captured the instruction and will execute it without question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Brief glance, then back to papers. Weight of finality. Closes the conversation with efficient understatement. No need for more.
